comments.text:
Polyunsaturated fats are in seed oils like Canola oil, sesame oil, grapeseed oil, and sunflower oil, all of which have a high smoke point and are best for things like stir-fry. They don't break down as quickly as fats or even olive oil.

Chefs like olive oil for the flavor, but it has a low smoke point, which means it will break down into bad-for-you chemicals at high temperatures like for stir fry.

Use olive oil in room-temperature foods like in dressings or drizzle on cooked foods.
